name: vecinosapp
description: Aplicación web para administrar recibos, prorrateos y pagos de un edificio.

scripts.dev: npm run build:client && tsx watch src/server.ts
scripts.build:client: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.browser.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.browser.chart.json && esbuild public/js/main.ts public/js/theme.ts public/js/share.ts --bundle --format=iife --minify --legal-comments=none --target=es2020 --outdir=public/js && esbuild public/js/consumption-chart.ts --bundle --format=iife --minify --legal-comments=none --target=es2020 --outfile=public/js/consumption-chart.js
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.browser.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.browser.chart.json
